title: Introducing Our New Bamboo Bicycle Frame-Building Jig
body_html:
We’re excited to share the launch of our latest product: the Bamboo Bicycle Club Frame-Building Jig – Version 6, now available at £595.

After years of refining our designs through workshops, builds, and community feedback, this new jig is our most streamlined and user-friendly version yet.

What Is a Frame-Building Jig?

A frame-building jig is the foundation of bicycle construction. It securely holds each tube in place, ensuring precise alignment while you join them together.

This version is optimised for bamboo but can also be adapted for other frame materials.

Key Features

Version 6 includes:

  • Durable aluminium construction – CNC-machined plates for accuracy and stability

  • Engraved measurement scales – etched directly onto the plates for easy geometry setup

  • Fully adjustable fixtures – vertical posts and sliding rails for different frame sizes and styles

  • Hand-operated knobs – black nylon with yellow caps for quick, tool-free adjustments

  • Engraved branding – Bamboo Bicycle Club logo and details, clearly displayed on each jig

How It Works

The jig makes frame building straightforward:

  1. Adjust the geometry using the built-in scales

  2. Secure bamboo (or other) tubes in place

  3. Maintain perfect alignment while joining the lugs

  4. Experiment with different bike styles by adjusting the setup

What’s New in Version 6

This sixth iteration builds on everything we’ve learned from earlier versions:

  • Simplified design with fewer parts for faster setup

  • A more intuitive adjustment system

  • Cleaner, more open workspace around the frame

  • Refined fixtures for smoother handling

Specifications

  • Price: £595

  • Material: CNC-machined aluminium

  • Assembly: Some self-assembly required

  • Shipping: UK and international delivery available

  • Included: All jig components plus setup instructions

Who It’s For

This jig is designed for:

  • First-time builders looking for precision and reliability

  • Workshop leaders running bamboo bike courses

  • Enthusiasts exploring custom geometry

  • Schools and universities teaching engineering or sustainable design

About Bamboo Bicycle Club
We provide tools, kits, and workshops for bamboo bicycle building, helping people design and build their own sustainable bikes. Based in the UK.
